profile.headline: Senior iOS Engineer | Engineering Manager | Fintech & Payments | Mobile, Backend & Platform Teams
profile.summary:
I lead engineering teams building secure, scalable payment platforms - from mobile apps to backend APIs - in fast-paced, regulated fintech environments. Over 15+ years, I've grown from hands-on engineer to engineering leader, coaching teams, driving technical strategy, and partnering with executives to ship reliable software at scale.

I have a proven track record of mentoring engineers, improving team performance, and delivering complex initiatives from concept through launch. I’m particularly passionate about creating systems that are not only technically sound, but also intuitive, scalable, and aligned with long-term business impact.

Key areas of focus:
• Engineering Team Leadership & Mentorship
• Hiring & Performance Management
• Mobile & Platform Architecture Strategy
• Cross-functional Program Delivery
• Agile/Scrum Delivery
• Secure systems & PCI-Compliant Applications
• Scalable API and SDK development
I’m currently focused on opportunities where I can lead engineering teams, drive technical strategy, and deliver impactful solutions at scale.

positions.title: Engineering Lead/Senior Java Developer
positions.description:
Led backend engineering initiatives for scalable enterprise microservices, partnering with cross-functional teams to deliver high-performance, reliable systems.

Led design and delivery of enterprise microservices using Java, Spring Boot, and RESTful architectures, driving scalability and system performance improvements

Established and enforced API standards using OpenAPI, improving cross-team integration consistency and reducing integration issues

Provided technical leadership in troubleshooting, debugging, and performance optimization, improving system stability and throughput

Guided engineering best practices by implementing automated testing strategies (JUnit, Mockito), increasing code quality and achieving high test coverage

Collaborated with DevOps, QA, and Product leadership to enhance CI/CD pipelines (GitLab), accelerating deployment cycles and improving release reliability

Contributed to architectural decisions and system design discussions, aligning technical solutions with business and operational goals

Participated in Agile/SAFe planning, influencing prioritization, delivery timelines, and cross-team coordination

Supported end-to-end delivery across the SDLC, ensuring alignment between technical execution and stakeholder expectations

positions.title: Engineering Lead/Senior Mobile Engineer
positions.description:
Led cross-functional engineering efforts for enterprise mobile payment platforms, collaborating with product, design, and leadership to deliver secure, scalable applications.

Led development and delivery of iOS and Android payment applications, driving architecture decisions and improving system scalability and performance

Partnered with product and business stakeholders to align engineering initiatives with company goals and regulatory requirements

Mentored and supported engineers through code reviews, technical guidance, and career development

Spearheaded implementation of PCI DSS-compliant security practices, reducing risk and ensuring secure transaction processing

Oversaw full product lifecycle, including planning, development, release management, and post-launch monitoring

Delivered reusable SDKs for iOS, Android, and macOS, enabling efficient partner integrations

Led application redesign efforts that improved user experience and increased adoption

Established testing and quality strategies, improving system reliability and reducing production issues

positions.title: Applications Developer
positions.description:
Developed enterprise mobile applications supporting internal operations across iOS and Android platforms.

Collaborated with cross-functional teams to design and deliver scalable mobile solutions

Presented technical concepts and project updates to executive stakeholders

Contributed to product design through wireframing and user experience alignment

Coordinated QA efforts and defect resolution, improving delivery timelines and product quality
